summary: RETEST of the iteration 5 fixes. All fixes PASS. Backend: pytest -n 0 34/34 pass. Manual check: a PUT that leaves out the new keys keeps resellers, pesananReseller and rusak; a PUT that sends returReseller:[] clears it; the old 4 keys are always written. FIX 2a: at 390x844, with TEST_A sold 2+2 and returned 4, deleting a sale is blocked with the toast 'Tidak bisa dihapus: TEST_A sudah diretur...'. Deleting the retur is blocked with 'stok TEST_A akan minus'. In both cases the rows stay, and the server data is unchanged. FIX 2b: hist-edit TEST_pr1, jml 2→1, Simpan is blocked with the toast 'TEST_A: sudah diretur 4 pohon...', and the server still has jml 2. Minor fixes: btn-retur and btn-rusak-reseller are both full width (358x52) and the label is not cut. toggle-reseller-row is 324x48; tapping the label row toggles it, and tapping the Switch directly toggles it once, with no double toggle. pakai-harga-reseller fills 18000+15000+5000 = 38000. Regression: a reseller order from the FAB saves and returns to the dashboard. Retur shows max 2 and raises TEST_C stock; rusak from 7 lowers it. Reseller counters are 6/5/1. Dashboard modal stays 120.000 after the reseller actions, then a main order saves (modal 125.000, total 290.000). Three minor issues are new.

ui_bugs.issue: After a save it calls router.back() with no canGoBack fallback (pesanan-baru.tsx:252 and the main branch). If the screen was opened directly or refreshed (no history), the screen does not close and the filled form stays. A second tap made a DUPLICATE reseller order; 2 identical records were reproduced. Use the same back() helper as reseller.tsx:231 (canGoBack ? back : replace('/dashboard')).

The link stays visible after it is used when ongkir or karantina > 0. The visibility condition compares transferN to totalJualReseller instead of the filled target (totalJualReseller + ongkir(if not COD) + karantina). pesanan-baru.tsx:598

integration_issues.issue: The retur guard (pesanan-baru.tsx:208-220) only checks the reseller now selected. In edit mode 'Ganti reseller' is still allowed, so moving a sale from reseller A (who has returns) to B gets past the guard and leaves A with returned > sold. Also check lama.resellerId when it differs, or turn off Ganti reseller while editing.

issues: The error toast sits over the 'Simpan perubahan' button at 390x844
